_comment: Dashboard preferences. Change the theme from inside the dashboard with
`t`, which writes this file. Available: Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Default.
Default inherits your terminal's own palette rather than overriding it.
watchlistSort is how the watchlist panel is ordered: move (biggest move
today), custom (your order, set with `w`) or symbol (A-Z). Press `s` with
the watchlist focused to change it.
